is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1, abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports Vgsc L995F (kdr-west, L1014F) and Ace-1 G280S (G119S) (page 1, abstract; page 4, methods).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for kdr and ace-1R for multiple populations and years (page 6).

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted on field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.l. in the Oueme region of Benin (page 2, methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field data collected between 2007 and 2010 (page 4, methods).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data for specific districts: Adjohoun, Dangbo, Misserete, and Seme (page 2, methods; page 3, Figure 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports data for 2007, 2009, and 2010 (page 4, methods; Table 1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific intervention campaign (IRS and LLIN distribution) and reports original data collected for this study.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study assessed the impact of three years of large-scale IRS (bendiocarb) and LLIN (deltamethrin) interventions on insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.s. in the Oueme region of Benin. It reports kdr (L1014F) and ace-1 (G119S) genotype frequencies and phenotypic resistance data from 2007 to 2010.
